This led to a systematic overcount, as it ignored the explicit sequence of 9 shuffles described in the visual timeline and instead inferred a continuous sequence of 15 based on frame indices.

analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misinterpreted the temporal structure of the video. The error was not due to visual misperception but to a failure in sequential reasoning and event mapping.
